blocks.subtitle: microRNA-based
blocks.claim: Three circulating microRNAs — miR-21, miR-24 and miR-155 — reflect inflammation, cellular ageing and metabolism. Their interplay is used to calculate a biological age, which is then set against the chronological one.
blocks.footer: Polaris Diagnostics Europe GmbH · Hamburg · www.polarisdx.net
blocks.benefit: A single figure that makes your conversation about exercise, stress and diet concrete.

blocks.caption: The principle
blocks.title: Not just how old you are. But how fast you are ageing.
blocks.lead: microRNAs are small RNA molecules that regulate how strongly individual genes are read. Three of them — miR-21, miR-24 and miR-155 — stand for inflammation, cellular ageing and metabolism. A regression model uses their interplay to calculate a biological age and sets it against chronological age. Because microRNAs respond dynamically, changes can show up comparatively quickly.

cards.title: Three signals
cards.text: miR-21 (inflammation), miR-24 (senescence and repair) and miR-155 (immune balance and metabolism).

cards.title: Dynamic
cards.text: microRNA levels change with diet, exercise, sleep, stress and smoking.

cards.title: Trend-oriented
cards.text: What carries meaning is the development between two measurements under the same conditions — not the single value.

flow.title: Measure
flow.text: Dried blood spot card, from the fingertip. microRNA expression by qPCR, normalised against miR-93. No fasting required.

flow.title: Interpret
flow.text: A multivariate regression model uses the three signals to calculate the biological age and its deviation from chronological age.

flow.title: Change
flow.text: Specific nutrition and lifestyle levers for each signal, plus follow-up monitoring at the next measurement.

blocks.title: How reliable is this figure?
blocks.text: The underlying model has been published as a pilot study (n = 539). It explains around 5% of the variance in age, the mean absolute error is 10.4 years, and two of the three microRNAs did not correlate significantly with chronological age in that work. The authors themselves call for validation before clinical use.
items: What this means in practice: the biological age reported here is not an age determination and says nothing about life expectancy or disease risk. What carries meaning is the change between two measurements under the same conditions — which is why this report centres on the trend and not on the single figure.

A comparison with methylation-based age clocks is not permissible: different methodology, different evidence base. Source: Schneider J. et al., miRNA-3Age, Frontiers in Nutrition 2025, doi:10.3389/fnut.2025.1659730.

blocks.caption: Your result
blocks.title: Your biological age clock.
blocks.text: From the combined evaluation of miR-21, miR-24 and miR-155. Chronological age 48 years. Your biological age is 52 years, four years above your chronological age. The range from −5 to +5 years is regarded as age-appropriate — your value therefore lies within this range. For context: the reference band of ±5 years is narrower than the model's mean error of 10.4 years. A deviation of this magnitude therefore cannot be distinguished from the model's scatter.

blocks.caption: Basis of the calculation
blocks.title: The three microRNAs.
blocks.lead: The individual signals on the traffic light 1–9; higher is better. Only their interplay produces the age clock — a single signal on its own does not permit any conclusion.

items.name: miR-21
items.intro: Lead microRNA of ‘inflammaging’. Rises with chronic, low-grade inflammation and is closely linked to senescence and fibrosis.
items.text: The weakest of your three signals. All eight recommendations in this report address the miR-21 pathway.

items.name: miR-155
items.intro: Central switch of the immune response. Elevated levels accompany metabolic stress and overactive inflammatory regulation.
items.text: In the lower middle range. Together with miR-21, this signal points in the same direction: inflammation and immune regulation are the axis of this report.

items.name: miR-24
items.intro: Regulates cell division, DNA repair and apoptosis. Reflects the repair capacity and senescence level of cells.
items.text: The strongest of your three signals — exactly in the middle of the scale. Repair capacity and senescence level are unremarkable.

blocks.note: In the publication describing the model, two of the three microRNAs did not correlate significantly with chronological age. The individual signals should therefore be read as starting points for interventions, not as age markers in their own right.

notices: Stress (4 out of 10) is your weakest lifestyle factor. In the model study, stress and smoking were among the factors associated with a higher miRNA age.
Tobacco (9 out of 10), by contrast, is well above average — so the second of the two factors that were unfavourable in the model does not apply to you.
Omega-3 (6) and exercise (7) have room for improvement; both are among the levers that were associated with a lower miRNA age in the study.
blocks.note: Assessment based on your self-reported information, not an individual diagnosis. The associations described come from the model study and are group findings, not a prediction for the individual case.

blocks.caption: Trend
blocks.title: The actual finding.
blocks.lead: Because the single value does not overcome the model's scatter, the informative value of this analysis lies in the trend. Only measured values are shown — no forecast.
blocks.note: Evaluation: initial measurement 15.03.2026, follow-up 15.06.2026, change −2 years, deviation today +4 compared with chronological age.

blocks.title: What the trend shows
blocks.text: Biological age has fallen by two years between the two measurements, from 54 to 52 — while chronological age rose by three months over the same period. The direction is right.
items: At the same time: a difference of two years lies well within the model's scatter of around ten years. A single step of this size does not yet demonstrate an effect — only a direction that stays consistent across several measurements does that.
The two measurements were around three months apart. The interval to the next check is set by the institution providing your care; sample collection and time of day should remain comparable.

blocks.caption: Summary
blocks.title: Your focus: the inflammation axis.
blocks.lead: Two of your three signals — miR-21 (3/9) and miR-155 (4/9) — describe inflammation and immune regulation, and both lie in the lower range. miR-24, which reflects repair and senescence, sits in the middle at 5/9. This produces a clear picture of where to focus.

focuses.title: Eat an anti-inflammatory diet
focuses.text: All eight levers in this report act on miR-21, six of them additionally on miR-155. The overlap is manageable and practical for everyday life. Specifically: oily sea fish twice a week or algal oil daily, 3–4 cups of green tea, turmeric with black pepper, broccoli cooked for 3–4 minutes at 80 °C, berries for resveratrol.

focuses.title: Stress and physical activity
focuses.text: Your lifestyle radar shows stress at 4 out of 10 as the weakest factor, with exercise at 7 and omega-3 at 6 leaving room for improvement. In the model study, stress and smoking were associated with a higher miRNA age, while regular physical activity and fish were associated with a lower one. Physical activity is the only lever that targets all three signals at once: at least 150 minutes per week, endurance and strength combined.

blocks.keepText: Not smoking (tobacco 9/10), fruit and vegetables (8/10) and fluid intake (8/10) are well above the reference group. The nutrition score of 72/100 is solid as well. And the trend is pointing in the right direction.
controlItems: All the associations described between lifestyle and miRNA age come from the model study and are group findings. Whether your personal value changes as a result of these measures can only be shown by your next measurement.
This report is not a diagnosis and does not replace medical advice.

What the analysis is suitable for
items.text: As a consultation and monitoring tool: it creates a concrete occasion, makes lifestyle topics tangible and, through repeated measurements under the same conditions, provides a trend line.

items.title: What it is not suitable for
items.text: As an age determination, as a statement about life expectancy or disease risk, as diagnostics — and as a basis for comparison with methylation-based age clocks, which rest on a different methodology and a different evidence base.
items.source: Schneider J. et al., miRNA-3Age: a microRNA-based biological age model and its modulation by lifestyle and nutrition. Frontiers in Nutrition (2025), doi:10.3389/fnut.2025.1659730

blocks.title: The guiding principle
blocks.text: The trend carries the meaning, the single value does not. An initial and a follow-up measurement under the same conditions are the real benefit of this analysis.

legal.title: Sample report
legal.text: All values and personal details in this document are fictitious and serve solely to illustrate the report format. This is not a real report.

legal.title: Interpretation
legal.text: The biological age reported here is a model value derived from three microRNA signals. The underlying model has been published as a pilot study; its mean absolute error is around ten years. The value is not an age determination, not a diagnosis and not a statement about life expectancy or disease risk. Informative value only emerges across several measurements under the same conditions. A comparison with methylation-based age clocks is not permissible.
